raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "have an orchard of plums"
  role subject "the user's brothers Grigore and Toader"
  role location "Bistrița Bârgăului"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "work"
  role subject "the user's brothers Grigore and Toader"
  role object "the orchard"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?o
  where match
    relation "be the owner according to documents"
    role subject ?o
    role object "the orchard"
    polarity affirmed
  end
